answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 8400 Country: India Title: I want ask u about that raat me apni biwi ke sath ham bistari karne ke bad subha ko bina nahaye kuch khana peena aur idhar udhar chalna kaisa hai? Question: Asslamvaleykum I want ask u about that raat me apni biwi ke sath ham bistari karne ke bad subha ko bina nahaye kuch khana peena aur idhar udhar chalna kaisa hai? Answer ID: 8400 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1275/1090=L/1429) In a state of impurity, one can eat and drink after washing his hands and mouth. Also, one is allowed to walk around. But, it is a major sin to remain in the same condition and miss the Fajr prayer. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
